notes: Rejected 2026-11-08, later (F-43): 52" panels are the widest this listing makes at 54" long, and the master bedroom's rod is about 75" (Andrew), so the pair is 104 / 75 = 1.39x, under the 1.5x minimum; LEMOMO's 66" Sea Teal (amazon-B0F6MTPGHV) takes the window. Flags: assumed-position:window (F-38). Read on its own page 2026-11-08: $31.49 the pack ($15.75 per count), In Stock, FREE delivery Tomorrow, November 9; the photo: "Two teal grommet-top curtain panels hung on a dark rod over a window", a muted blue-green linen look with a white back. The master bedroom's blackout pair, matched to the bedding: Andrew, 2026-11-08: "for bedroom, we're going with darker wood frame and nightstand (check), and going with teal/green/blue sheets / blankets. was thinking it could be something closer match to that for the blackout curtains." Why Teal (F-68 (9)): it sits between the blue and the green of the bedding, so it ties to all three; teal against the RÅDMANSÖ's brown walnut is a classic pairing, it stands off the cream walls instead of melting into them, and it is the cool counterweight to the honey-oak floor and window frames. A darker blackout also hides the glow at its seams better than ivory. The listing's other colors in this size: Stone Blue (B09YNC9B2Z, $33.49, a dusty slate blue: the softer choice if the bedding is mostly blue), Sage (B09YND1C4C, $31.49, gray-green: if mostly green), Navy (B07P4DVGTR, $31.49), Blue Sapphire, Green Bay, Glacier Gray and the heathered ones at $39.95. Fit (F-43): 54" long with grommets (fit rods up to 1.5"), on the rod already in place 2 to 3" above the 50" window: the panels end at the sill; one pack, 2 x 52" = 104", 1.55x the 67" window · fits. 4.6 stars (26,169, the listing's). rooms: master-bedroom, from Andrew's word.
